rule: VALID if each positive control (pigmentation, blue-whitish veil) has its target concept as the largest effect, positive and significant (two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-trajectory slopes, BH-corrected p < 0.05, median slope > 0), in at least 3 of 4 bases (the same share of the available bases), and the largest |effect| of the permuted-label control is below 0.25 x the median largest |effect| of the melanoma classifiers. NOT VALID otherwise.
